method.engine: Actual FightEngine.update/render; native Canvas drawImage observed after executing its real draw.
method.inputs: Only original InputState keydown/keyup callbacks receive synthetic events. No held/pressed sets or actor positions, facing, health, phase, clocks or attack objects are assigned.
method.oppositeSides: Separate ordinary local duels put each controlled fighter in the real player1 or player2 spawn. No teleport, actor swap or pose injection.
method.decoder: Exact source bytes verified. Sharp normalizes PNG encoding only in memory for native decoding; all decoded RGBA bytes compared.
method.rolePolicy: Only existing combat-enabled profiles enter duels. Other roles receive native workshop-renderer views only; no role or permission is changed.

limits: Native Canvas is not Chromium; DOM/CSS, actual browser keyboard delivery, HTTP, service worker and CI browser behavior are not tested.
Timing and mirrored left views are authored versus presentation; no original film/game animation timing or 1:1 fidelity is certified.
These wave23 candidates are exercised through idle, permitted static-frame movement or stationary-input rejection, and release-to-idle; no attack/contact/guard/finisher matrix is exercised.
Skull/torso size, foot contacts and limb identity still require visual review of the native captures.
cataloguePolicy: The whole catalogue is hashed before/after this process. Later unrelated imports may change its global hash; aggregation must still require exact tested-entry hashes and unchanged renderer/gameplay modules.
